tools.description: Create projects, tags or folders in one batch. parent is a folder id (project, folder) or tag id (tag); omit for the root. Optional status (project Active/OnHold/Done, tag Active/OnHold). Project only, named as in add_tasks: type, defer/due/planned, flagged, note, tags by id or name, estimatedMinutes, repetition {rule (RRULE), scheduleType, anchor, catchUp}, completedByChildren. Returns one result per item (id, ok/error, name, status, parent); a bad item does not stop the others.

tools.description: Permanently delete tasks, projects, tags or folders. IRREVERSIBLE. Guards: a tag or folder is deleted only when already dropped and empty (delete children first); a task or project is deleted only without remaining (incomplete) tasks or subtasks; drop it instead. Returns one result per item; a refusal comes back as that item's error with the reason.

items.description: objects to act on, applied in order

tools.name: delete

tools.description: Drop tasks, projects, tags or folders. Reversible through this server: projects, tags and folders by edit status Active, tasks by edit_tasks restore true. Dropping a project drops its tasks; dropping a folder drops its projects. Guard enforced by OmniFocus script: a tag is refused while it or any descendant tag has remaining tasks (untag or complete them first). Returns one result per item; a refusal comes back as that item's error.

items.description: objects to act on, applied in order

tools.name: drop

tools.description: Patch projects, tags or folders in one batch: rename; project status Active/OnHold/Done; tag status Active/OnHold; folder status Active restores a dropped folder; project only, named as in edit_tasks: type, note, flagged, defer/due/planned, estimatedMinutes and repetition (null clears these), tags {add, remove} by id or name, completedByChildren; review (project only): reviewInterval {steps, unit}, nextReviewDate (truncated to local midnight), reviewed true to mark reviewed now (recomputes nextReviewDate; not with nextReviewDate); move under a parent id or to the root (parent null); reorder before or after a sibling of the same kind. Folders: rename, move, reorder, restore. Dropping and deleting are separate tools. Returns one result per item.

reviewed.description: mark reviewed now; OmniFocus recomputes nextReviewDate from the interval

tools.description: List tasks. Filters are AND-combined. *_after bounds are on or after, *_before bounds on or before; a date-only value covers its whole local day, and a task without that date never matches. Nothing hides completed or dropped tasks unless a filter does (available, completed, dropped); completed_* bounds match completed tasks only. Limit defaults to 50; null returns all.

added_after.description: added on or after; a date-only value starts at 00:00. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

available.description: true: not blocked, deferred, completed or dropped

completed.description: only completed tasks (true) or only not-completed tasks (false)

completed_after.description: completed on or after; a date-only value starts at 00:00. Matches completed tasks only. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

completed_before.description: completed on or before; a date-only value covers its whole day. Matches completed tasks only. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

defer_after.description: defer date on or after; a date-only value starts at 00:00. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

defer_before.description: defer date on or before; a date-only value covers its whole day. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

dropped.description: only dropped tasks (true) or only not-dropped tasks (false)

due_after.description: due on or after; a date-only value starts at 00:00. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

due_before.description: due on or before; a date-only value covers its whole day. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

inbox.description: only inbox tasks (true) or only non-inbox tasks (false)

modified_after.description: modified on or after; a date-only value starts at 00:00. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

planned_after.description: planned date on or after; a date-only value starts at 00:00. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

planned_before.description: planned date on or before; a date-only value covers its whole day. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

repeating.description: only tasks with a repetition rule (true) or only non-repeating tasks (false)

search.description: case-insensitive substring over name and note

untagged.description: only tasks without tags (true) or only tagged tasks (false)
